items.text: REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT

items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S2844

 TITLE OF BILL :

An act to amend the private housing finance law, in relation to tax
exemptions for projects of housing development fund companies


 PURPOSE :

This bill would require that the New York City Council act on this
important legislation within 120 days.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Subdivision 1 of section 577 of the Private housing finance law is
amended by adding a new paragraph (d).

 JUSTIFICATION :

Article 11 Housing Development Funding Companies ("HDFC"s) are
indispensible in providing low income housing in New York City. Due to
their not for profit status and the statutory requirements that the
residents of the housing they produce and rehabilitate must be low
income, they generally have little margin in covering the monthly
maintenance and operation of their housing developments. They are
currently eligible for a deep property tax exemption pursuant to State
Law. Without such exemption the HDFC would have difficulty maintaining
their developments due to the increased costs that would be incurred.

This bill ensures that when an HDFC is eligible for a real property
tax exemption through Article 11, that the local legislative body who
approves such exemption must act within 120 days of its submission.
Under current law, the time frame by which the local legislative body
may act is often resulting in lengthy delays before the approval of
such an exemption and creating a tremendous financial hardship to the
HDFC.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

This is new legislation.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None to the state.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.
